name: Special Topics in Cryptography and Cryptanalysis
description: The topics covered will be based on current trends and emerging technology in cryptography and cryptanalysis. They may include advanced concepts in key generation, symmetric key cryptography, asymmetric key cryptography, elliptic curve cryptography, privacy-preserving authentication, homomorphic encryption, and post quantum cryptography.
